notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! 👋

It's been almost half a year since the release of Miniland Adventure. What a journey it was! We'd like to thank all of you who followed us on any step of it 😊. We wonder how many of you were with us from the very beginning, let us know in the comments! 💖 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/27e8d86332861556cd7cd4023475538699fa450b.png

We couldn't imagine better moment to say the following statement, so without further ado:

The long awaited patch is live! 😯🔥 Last time, we've briefly introduced some of its contents and today, we'll show you all of the novelties! 🤩 

In case you've just started following us on Steam, let's take a quick look at the already announced changes and move on to the features yet to be uncovered. 📝

-New kind of enemy: witches! 🧹
Those vile enemies skilled in magic will spell your doom with their AoE degeneration ground- approach. The witches reside both in the overworld and enchanted dimension!

-New building: healing statue! ➕
This statue offers a powerful healing aura in its vicinity. Can become a powerful defensive structure if placed strategically! 🛡️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/1fcdb389f6e71e3fe62d3c1f02f45434704c75dd.png
-In-game biome modding! 🗺️
Create your own completely unique biome tiles using all the elements available in game. It's time to let your imagination run wild! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2aface4937972c8ca6ba486e9a0541bebc5f1f07.png
-New object: Anvil 🔨
Repair old, used up weapons and tools. Let them have a second life. 

-New object: Text Sign 🛑
Ability to Create and place signs with custom Text, resembling the ones in the tutorial. We wonder what kind of use they will find in your worlds. 🤔

-New weapon: Hammer ⚒️
This will become a refreshing addition in your arsenal. Although it's slow, the high damage and range compensates for it allowing you to wreak havoc whenever you choose to weld it! 

-New growable flower! 🌸
The patch allows you to have a bigger bunch of flowers growing in your biomes, by growing them with a use of bone meal!

-Goblins are immortal! 
No more losing your green friends accidentally.😁

-Fixed duplication bug
The bug making objects drop duplicated items if destroyed by multiple projectiles. 

Last but not least, we've added modding document action available for everyone in the "help" section of the mod menu. You can find hints on modding the game in our previous post so be sure to take a look there!

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1934040/view/3736356443994842337

We can't wait to see what kind of use you will make with the new features presented in the patch. Join our discord 👇and let us know! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/98fe03af0748de84689470794a42c6e07b0687ec.png

See you soon, 
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.title: Mods
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! 👋

The update is just around the corner and before it’s launched we’d like to give you some heads up about the feature most of you are eagerly waiting for- the modding process. Therefore, this detailed instruction is issued! 👍

To get the process started, first you have to enter the new biome section.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/b0a4bdc492cb673155526bd0454163edd4608028.png
When you open it, a big panel will appear. It has all the details about the biome you create. Let’s take a closer look at each of them, shall we? 🔍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2aface4937972c8ca6ba486e9a0541bebc5f1f07.png
Biome Name
Choose a suitable name for your creation in the center top tile. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/6b283443ebc895331aebad50fb227a3a63cb7253.png
Tile Type
This option dictates what type of ground will appear on the biome and consequently, what kind of monsters you will encounter there. 🧟

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/20166ccc4fb09be9e8ff18a872041343b45f2aba.png
Biome Type
Once you’ve decided on the type of tiles you have to decide what kind of Underground and Enchanted Dimension appears on your map. Select carefully to ensure the best effect! 💪

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/f0d23e7355ba6dd263c2ecc01c1189ed7dc2f148.png
Mobs and Objects
Once you’ve decided the looks on your biome we can start putting objects on it. On the biomes, you can put up to one mob and 5 objects. Each of them has a number right to their name. This number represents the percentage chance for appearance of said object/mob. 

Let’s take a look at the example below and talk about the math behind it 📝

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/7e518c4d167f0dc60968e5eae91625373baf1465.png
As you can see, the objects’ chances in the example sum up to 27.5%. What it basically means is that about 27.5% of tiles on that biome will have some kind of object or mob when placed, while the rest of the area will have nothing on it. In the area taken by objects, the chances for each specific one are proportional to the values you’ve set.

Make sure to have the total chances for the objects not exceed 100%, otherwise some objects will not be able to spawn at all. 🙁

And this is how the final effect looks like:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/29aaea752d35547f0944625b7deea55d895fdf24.png
How to disable/enable or remove mods
if you have mods that you don’t want to activate at the moment, you can simply disable or enable the ones you’d like to have again in the mod manager section.

All you have to do is to click on the big round button to the left of the mod’s name and voila, you’ve disabled/enabled the mod. By the way, to the right there is a delete button in case you don’t want to have the mod anymore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/783a7f3d7fe3fdffa07f67208e54298c8d6ef9ef.png
How to add mods
We’d like to allow the community to share their creations with each other hence we introduced a way to add mods created by other people. The procedure is really simple and quick.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/e1559b23af8c817a5674523b8edd9067f2bca86b.png
All you have to do is download the mod file you’d like to add and place it in the mod folder. Pay attention so that the file has the .json format. To quickly enter this folder, all you have to do is to click the folder button in the Modding window in the game. Don’t forget to restart your game afterwards 🙂

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/03e81a31da015286d439df72b231f6f6a031459c.png
Hopefully you’ll find this instruction helpful and clear. If you’d like us to address any other mechanic in the game with an instruction news like this one don’t hesitate to let us know on our discord 👇 or in the comments/discussions on Steam. We can’t wait to see where creativity takes you once the patch is released. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/98fe03af0748de84689470794a42c6e07b0687ec.png

See you soon,
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.title: Novelties!
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! 👋

It’s been a while since you’ve heard from us but we’re finally back with information about another content patch. 🤩 Today, we’d like to give you a glimpse of what’s going to be introduced in the future update! 🔥

The developer works tirelessly to bring new content to the game and the first feature he’s prepared for you is in-game biome modding! 😀 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/c14adc56d50d5b5ce6200411674dcbef6ece1a7c.png
With this we’d like to give you even more freedom. Create custom biomes using various resources available in the game such as animals, objects and more! 🤯 Once saved, you’ll be able to obtain and place the biomes just as you’d do with the standard ones. We can’t wait to see where your creativity will take you so make sure to share your projects with us on our discord! 👇

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/732e78bb6bb96f2dcf7dd9ba3563963474b96e82.png

Let’s take a look at a biome we’ve prepared for demonstration purposes- the Moth Biome.🔍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/3d13abc0a81bf172e1522752610fe2b939dd8555.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/df576a61c4de223b4f67eb3b6c489e81d4c7dcff.png
The sheer amount of possible combinations will allow you to have a world like no other player! 🙂

This content patch will also bring new objects, like a healing statue ➕ which as the name implies gives a healing aura in a small area around it. This object will allow you to heal up after a tough battle or even support you during combat if built strategically. ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/1fcdb389f6e71e3fe62d3c1f02f45434704c75dd.png
On top of that, you’ll encounter new enemies - witches. They are aggressive beings skilled in magical art who use their AOE degeneration magic to bring demise to the players. ☠️ You can meet two kinds of witches, the normal ones reside in the main dimension while the other, even more dangerous dwell in the depths of the enchanted dimension. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/3347e2d491d77f8dbfe73f726b9a2434e063fa73.png
Those are just some of the features the patch will bring to the game 📝 so make sure to keep a close eye on the notifications and newses because we’ll reveal even more features as the update is near! 🔥

See you soon
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.title: Major Update 🔔
notes.content:
Hello players! 

Today we come to you with great news, and the finale of our work over the past weeks!

Last time we described to you some of the new features that will appear in our game with the upcoming game update. These included new biomes, new objects to create and also new creatures, eg. cats 🐈 which can be tamed 💘

While we did not give you a specific release date at the time, we will not keep you in suspense any longer. The update is now available! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/7649938efb0389413dc83d80d713cbb1e005d594.png


With it comes even more news and surprises we have prepared for you 😀.


New passive mobs 👹:


 Jellyfish 🐠, appearing in the enchanted forest.
 A cat 😼 that you can tame by wearing a collar! Tamed cats will follow you and you can also let them sit in one place .



Biomes 🧊 : 


 Cherry blossom forest 🌸, giving you the opportunity to make decorations, floors and walls out of pink wood 🪓

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/57486eb955de9828e7b302da21891b506f9ac2a8.png

 Limestone cave 🕳️ , where you will find materials such as : limestone, stalagmites or polluted water, and get the opportunity to create: limestone floors, walls and decorations 🎍

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/009bfba770ded06b1afe0633a104fc3ca49d161b.png

 Charred forest 🌳 🔥 , will be a good place to collect dark pepper, charred tree, and glowing bugs which will be a great raw material to create colorful night lights! 🏮

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/b95a4b6fd27eed3d3fff973ef3cff2777714ef7d.png



New trap 😛 :
 

 A spiked trap that deals damage to anyone who steps on it 🗡️




Additional patches and fixes 🛠️ :  

Improvements :


 added interactive UI animations
 slightly changed stone wall sprites to make it more appealing
 added a mention in the tutorial about collecting liquids
 added light to explosions


Fixes:

[olist]
 fixed a bug where some monsters could be duplicated when being saved for the first time
 fixed a bug where ungrown acacia would drop standard log instead of red log
[/olist]



Thank you for being with us and continuing to support us! 
We hope you will enjoy the new content and improve the positive feeling from playing our Miniland Adventure!


We invite you to our discord, where we share interesting facts related to the production of :

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png


See you soon,
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.content:
Hello players! 🤝

It's been a month since the release of the full version of our Miniland Adventure! 📆 During this time we have collected a lot of feedback, kind words and constructive criticism from you 🥳 for which we sincerely thank you.

We want to gladly inform you that your requests and suggestions are not sent to us in vain, and we plan to further develop our Miniland Adventure game 😀 And now, in this post, we'll let out a bit of a secret and describe to you what will be included in the upcoming update in the near future. New opportunities, a new area to explore and new animals.... 🐈

In the upcoming update you will have the unique opportunity to discover and enjoy the beauty of the new "Cherry blossom tree biome" 🌸 
But that's not all!
There will also be a new "Underground biome" 🤯 and an "Enchanted dimension biome" ✨

That couldn't be all 🙂 Due to your requests, there will also be brand new animals and monsters living in new biomes in Miniland Adventure. Among other things, player-friendly, adorable cats will appear! 😼


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/8924132664ec6da5c45e3cca360827b841918676.png

Of course, these are not all the novelties we are planning for the upcoming update 👍 We will describe the rest to you at a slightly later date ⏰


Remember that we are still working on the content of this update and it will take us some more time. We want the new content of the game to meet your expectations the most 🎉 Expect to hear more about the upcoming update, and join our Discord, as it's also there, you have a say in the news coming to the game!

notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.0.6
notes.content:
Version 1.0.6 changelogs:
 improved pathfinding for mobs (fixes regarding mobs getting out of closed spaces when outside of the screen in some cases)
 improved gameplay smoothness
 increased price of quartz tools sold by a smith goblin

notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.0.5
notes.content:
Version 1.0.5 changelogs:
 Fixed a bug where goblin's could "forget" their beds.
 Lowered drops from vegetables (eg. radishes, broccoli etc.) - we've seen it was too easy to get a lot of vegetables.
 Increased time of items laying on the ground before disappearing (2 min -> 4 min) - we want to prevent accidents when you left items on the ground (eg. when moving the chests) and didn't managed to pick them up in time.
 Added sorting button to player's inventory.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/de3ee9ce10f881e9baf1534c830719772f1d29f7.png

Regards,
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.title: UPDATE | VERSION 1.0.4
notes.content:
Version 1.0.4 changelogs:
  Adjusted drops for crystal omen.
 Changed armchair and couch to be made with leather instead of feathers.
 Fixed a bug where there would be a notification showing a picked item with the count of 0 (when having full inventory).
 Increased day length by 25%.

notes.title: Tips & Tricks
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers! 👋

We hope you had no problems playing Miniland! 
However, if you struggled with anything on your way, we have some tips in this beginner's guide for you!


1. First of all you should know how to create your world!
Every morning you will be able to choose new biome cards. The indicator will show you if there are new cards available, in case you forgot!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/a6b2dabfd293c245c34cf849d2a9102d40b82be8.png


Open and close editing mode with SPACE, and select biomes you want to receive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/6dd4ed136c914bb8ede1bbd631cd49f3673c12f0.png


Once received you can select which ones you like and place them where you want too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/7611c9430685a7d9657799a0a4b9d508d160cc4f.png



2. Keep an eye on your health, hunger and thirst!
With time you will become more hungry and more thirsty. You can choose from a variety of food like: cooked meat, vegetables, eggs, nuts or soups!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/47aa416456e33368f8e69fa938734b3e1b75118c.png


For drinking, the most recommended option is sweet water! You can collect salt water from the ocean with an empty cup or a bucket with RMB. After that, boil it in the furnace to get sweet water. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/6a562b4d68cde158d8b887fcd973fe407bd1b015.png

You can also get sweet water from other sources eg. by melting snow in a bucket.



3. Craft a bed or prepare weapons!
You shouldn’t worry about surviving the first 3 nights… but after that, on each night monsters will appear!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/0e2d5237d3bb67ae0d1d5715b15aa55ee11d1118.png


Make sure you have a comfy bed ready to sleep in for the night or weapons ready to take on enemies!
Also remember to place torches and lamps around as well as building a house! Monsters won’t appear in lit places, which is a perfect solution too!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/a7d7638556df5607dbeea68c19f279bcc6da6a3d.png



4. Don’t forget about the ladder!
Once you craft or find the ladder, be sure to check where it can lead you! You’ll find plenty of useful resources in the underground, just don’t forget to take a few torches and a sword on your way!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/6b840d605f63987ed0f6cdaa37aad31fb1f563c8.png



5. Make friends with the goblins!
Along your adventure you will meet several goblins. Don’t worry, they’re friendly! Each of them have different professions and different trade offers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/e2a0a66330583246a6404e532a7ea4dea1992501.png

Trade offers are dependent on their satisfaction level. First you’ll need to place a goblin’s bed nearby them. After that check what furniture and building materials they like, and build a beautiful house for them! Place the furniture in the goblin’s bed area.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/6b91e9517c8acddd03c4f56bbe4acd8c1ea20d3d.png

That way they'll be happy and you will get access to awesome trades in exchange!



6. Check the help in-game, or ask on our discord server!
We’ve explained the most important basics in this guide, but you might still have some questions left. Be sure to check out the tutorial available from the game menu…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/cc8109d3d72f6ce0ea506cda2fe63c8058366782.png

… or a tutorial book that can be opened whenever you like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/104544eb20dc487db12b2dc39347ce9037faf9db.png



The last option (that we highly recommend) is to join our Discord server!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png

Here you can ask for help, discuss the game, suggest new features and be up-to-date with the latest news!


Happy playing!
Miniland Adventure Team

notes.title: Game modes, difficulty settings, thirst and all kinds of water💦
notes.content:
Hello Minilanders!⛏️
We have a lot of news coming to you about the development of the game, lots of new stuff for every type of player to enjoy!🤗

New items and what to use them for!🥤
You can get salt water from an ocean🌊 by using a bucket or a cup (new item yay!) which was added in this update.
Sweet water is acquirable by collecting it with a bucket from the enchanted dimension 🧝‍♂️ or by boiling the salt water in a furnace.🔥

Additionally a new water distributor enables storing sweet water and dispensing it at any given time (up to 8 cups storage wise).📠
Bucket holds as much as 3 cups but you can’t drink out of it. Cups can also be stacked as well as a great number of other items so you can hold many of them in your inventory.🤓
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/9f8b87951b0fa671ad2b70079e7080e9fed74733.png
Introducing, thirst😫
Thirst works the same way as food - it gradually falls until it reaches 0, then the player starts receiving damage. The difference is however that regenerating health uses food points, but water level won’t get reduced (a little less to worry about!).🚱

Modes and difficulty levels 🎮
Survival mode is the standard one that’s always been there. In the creative one however we get access to all the items which we can add to our inventory when we want!
We also can’t die💀 meaning when our health points go down to zero, nothing will happen and we can peacefully continue with what we were doing.👼
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/297fac0f610515fa7ccf130c9b9591011083546d.png
Separate from that, there’s also the ability to choose different difficulty levels (no monsters, easy, normal, hard).
No monsters means everything else is the same, the only thing that changes is that when it’s night; the monsters won’t spawn.👺
Easy difficulty means less damage received and more food, water and health points gained.😌
Hard mode is the opposite of easy and has a purpose to give you more challenge if you like to fight with monsters.⚔

“Localization”
We are also working on localizing the game and soon there will be much more languages available to enjoy the game in!🥳
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/593bf7e017a7fd09ed84646d6706770b23d79af4.png
That’s all the news from us (just for now 😉), we hope you enjoyed this update and are excited for the things to come!

If you are as excited as we are, come talk with us on the Discord!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png

Also, add the game to your wishlist to get the newest information about the game delivered straight to you!

The Miniland Team

This month, much of our work has been focused on creating a new area to explore, mine, harvest new plants and fight scary monsters!
The passage to it leads you through a portal that you will be able to create 👏


We have made every effort to refine the new dimension as much as possible! Large magic mushrooms, magic trees, grass, water to give the right atmosphere, lava - all this will create a unique environment that we hope will delight you 🤩.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/dcefbc025222c48f14118125aabc0deef20a5857.gif



New objects in-game 🪑

That's not all ❗ 
The game will also feature brand new materials for building furniture, walls or floors - which will allow you to build even better buildings.

Are you curious if something else will appear? Of course 🙂 To craft some magical objects, you will also need an enchanted crafting table!  To create them, you will need the right magical objects and raw materials - including the new "Obsidian", which is a rather fragile but extremely powerful raw material - and as a result, you will get a unique opportunity to create other magical objects too! Among them, a soup of magic mushrooms that gives extra life 🍄.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/5b33642f93c43808ca9d7d8d481c8642c3022053.gif



All-new monsters 👹


The new monsters appearing in the Enchanted Dimension will be as interesting as the location itself 😎 They will be : 

👻 Ghost - only appears when it is close to the player, it is impossible to attack it from afar. You are left with a skirmish in a direct confrontation 👊

🧱 Mimic - Hides in the walls in the enchanted dimension, reveals itself when you hit it.

🔫 Cultist - Shoots several projectiles at once, charging his projectiles continuously. In an ongoing battle he will be able to fire fewer projectiles, but after a long pause he will be able to attack the player with more of them, creating a salvo! 


Keep your eyes peeled and be careful ⛑️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/ca6378abbc487dc37245e46206dde0dc91bc4c0e.gif




Other enhancements and novelties added to the game:


- A new weapon : spear that has a large damage and the ability to throw it

- Better floor system. Floor now adjusts to the walls built instead of sticking outside the houses.



Thank you for being with us, and we invite you to join our Discord! There you will be able to talk with both the game's creator and other players interested in similar game topics 👇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png


We also encourage you to add the Miniland game to your Wishlist. That way you won't miss any information about our game! 👌
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland/

See You soon,
Miniland Team

notes.title: Devlog#2 - Exploding spiders
notes.content:
🎮  Hello players!  🎮
It's high time to attack you with another dose of knowledge on Miniland development. 

For today we have prepared a lot of different kinds of new gameplay elements - from the environment of our map to completely new monsters :) A real rarity for any fan.

LET'S BEGIN!



The first and very interesting issue is spiders 🕷️ and the ability to craft weapons from them and fully functional goblins :

Spiders  🕷️  appear in the most convenient environment for them - the underground. They are extremely dangerous, cunning and have an "explosive" character  💥  Literally 😎
After their death they mercilessly explode thus inflicting damage on us. But to give you something in return, you have the opportunity to take from them an explosive substance that will allow you to build a bomb.  💣


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/3afc2cf59ab19c7f1c057130bc8b418f487d81f3.gif



Goblins 👺 are very interesting and definitely important characters in our game. 
They appear every few days, right after laying down new biomes. Since they will not have any shelter once we approach them, they will follow us. 
In the game there is an option to build them a bed  🛏️, which they will take ownership of after we lead them to it. 
From there, it's a straightforward way to raise their satisfaction level by building them a nice house with furniture that matches their tastes! Remember - the higher the goblin's satisfaction, the better offers you’ll get 💰 The items they sell will be directly related to the profession a particular goblin has, so it's important to treat each of them as well as possible. As if that wasn't enough, some of the items are only available to buy from goblins and can't be obtained in any other way (e.g. pumpkin seeds).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/473980c793da3e22b9434e5536b2d937c00340f5.gif



Raise the satisfaction level of your goblins and enjoy fantastic trade offers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/a4f3ac8d70659ef84b07c3878d13364497321e53.gif



Next in line are changes to the UI windows, facilitation and the overall look of the map :

- We have adapted the entire UI of the game to larger monitors, so that everything is more readable for you.
- We've redesigned the furnace in such a way that it doesn't burn objects immediately, but as time passes. Of course, we also added all-new fantastic animations and effects :)
- We increased the number of objects in one stack from 8 to 16
- Ability to build vertical doors
- Now only part of the biomes is random, the rest is adjusted so that we have the greatest possible variety of terrain





At the very end we left the biggest surprise that will eminently catch your eye ! Water in the background of the game !  🌊 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/06230df071a78c2be02bb7fdcb07dd5706f113c6.gif

So far, only the steady color was visible in the background. We decided to give you more fun and a sense of boundlessness - the sea. 🌊   No more great emptiness, from now on there will be something to look at! 



What do you think about these types of changes? Let us know here or on our discord 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/2e36a88b0f2bd5a1c8b85eee8a3faf803168103a.png


If you are curious about the next devlog, be sure to add miniland to your steam Wishlist 


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland/



See You Soon,
Miniland Team

notes.title: Devlog #1 New monsters and tools
notes.content:
Hello Players! 👋 
How are you? We hope you are fine and are ready for a whole new dose of information about our MINILAND game!

Ready? Let's start ❗

There are many tools in the game that we need to expand and protect our land.

Among others, these are: Sword
 Axe
 Pickaxe
 Slingshot  and more
SHEARS FOR SHEARING SHEEP 🐑  joined the group of these tools! 
But don't worry, that's not all - in addition to the possibility of obtaining wool, there is also the durability of the tool you are using. So be careful what and how you do as any tool you use in the game will break after long use. 💔

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/c1633515b251bb664d4da85c06ee204507bc6790.gif

In addition to new tools, Miniland also has a new monster that threatens our land:

Mummy. 
The mummy will appear on sand biomes and will attack us with fireballs to scare us away from its territory!  🔥

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/6357a9799ce5d3a3a4d8359d90be867309384aa1.gif

We've also started work on Goblin  😈  NPCs we'll be building rooms for, and we'll talk more about them in the next devlogs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/e5e8227e3a238c77ef0730dc77f8474d696af432.gif

We make every effort to ensure that you enjoy the game in every aspect, including the visual experience. We've added a lot of cool ambient effects to make it much easier for you to get into the atmosphere of our game.

Imagine it: The flickering lights of a torch, a path through an endless clearing full of flowers and a skeleton coming out from around the corner … ☠️

Fantastic, right? 

Remember that you decide what your world will look like! 💪 

Other changes:
 Gamepad support added
 Improved optimization, allowing more mobs in one area
 Bug fixes

Finally, we would like to invite you to our server on DISCORD, where you can share your suggestions with us and chat directly with the Game Developer! 👇 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42228901/732e78bb6bb96f2dcf7dd9ba3563963474b96e82.png

Add Minilad to your Steam Wishlist to stay up to date with all the information and news about our production!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1934040/Miniland/

See You soon,
Miniland Team

notes.title: Update v0.11
notes.content:
I've finished working on the 11th update for Miniland, which means we're slowly but steadily closer to the release.

Some of the new features are:

 Added over 40 sounds and a first music that plays in the morning
 New monster - a snowman spawning on ice biome and shooting ice cubes
 Added swords for a melee combat
 Lasso can be used to tie animals and drag them around
 Bone meal made from bones, used to speed up growing plants
 Ostriches now lay eggs which you can hatch or eat
 New UI look and improved crafting
 "Mountain" biome - a biome with big stone chunks on the surface
 Mouse sprites
 Many bug fixes and improvements
